what.text: This page follows refugees from Ghana living in Togo, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 8437 Ghanaian refugees in Togo, 52.6% of all refugees from Ghana.
Togo is the largest host of Ghanaian refugees, followed by Canada, the United States and Germany.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Ghana in 1966, 1981 and 1983, with military factions in 1981 and 1983.
The fact pack records no armed conflict in the main years of displacement, so it does not say why people left then.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1961 at 5000 refugees, and the figure fell to a low in 1982.
It rose again, reaching its highest point, 18476, at the end of 2015; the main years of displacement in the data are 1994 to 2004 and 2010 to 2019.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Togo.
These are year-end totals for Togo only, reported to UNHCR.
